analysis.reasonEn: Maintained observation for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has moved down from overbought territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram is improving but still showing weak convergence, indicating a lack of direction. Volume is also subdued, making it difficult to interpret as a trend reversal signal.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($57.54) vs SMA5/20/50 ($57.07/$56.74/$55.98) — short/mid-term trend above, long-term trend support level
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($55.84/$55.50) — healthy long-term trend strength
· 52-week position (50.8%) + current price historically at mid-level
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (57.1 → 67.9) — entered overbought, now consolidating in neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0293 → 0.0567) — improving, weak convergence continues
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $56.74) — band width 2.31%, moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
